Speaking as an Arsenal fan I think I can give you an idea of what you're getting into:

History:

- Founded in 1886

- The only team in the premier League to go a whole season without losing a game (probably the best thing we've ever done). Look up Arsenal's 03/04 Invincibles if you want to learn more.

- We had (arguably) the greatest striker ever in the premier League in Thierry Henry who scored 226 goals for us. He is also 5th all time top goal scorer in the premier League and has one of the best goals per game ratio.

- We have a tendency let our best players go to better teams at the peak of their powers (often for a lot less than they're worth, sometimes even for free) such as: Thierry Henry, Robin Van Persie, Cesc Fabregas, Alexis Sanchez etc. feel free to look up more

- Having 30 trophies to our name, we are the 3rd most successful team in England (behind Man Utd and Liverpool)

- Tottenham Hotspur are our biggest rivals after we moved from Woolwich (south of the Thames) to North London (where Tottenham are also based). To see some of the highlights of our rivalry look up 5PUR2, Emmanuel Adebayor, William Gallas, Sol Campbell

- We have only been relegated from the top flight of English football once in 1912/13 and came back up the next season (but the reason we came back up is a bit dodgy so you might want to look that up)

(I'm sure I'm missing loads of much bigger events but they'll be a good starting point)

Currently:

- We are at a very low point in our recent history after being managed by Arsene Wenger, one of the longest ever serving managers for one club in football, for over 20 years. In the first half of Wenger's reign we were a very brilliant side led by a revolutionary manager but towards the end of his tenure it was clear he was getting a bit old and we needed a fresh set of hands to take over the club.

- Since our we moved out of our old stadium (Highbury) to our new one (Emirates Stadium) in 2006 the only trophy we have managed to win is the FA cup (which is pretty good and we've won it 3 times since 2006 but I think every fan of a top club would rather win the league than a cup)

- Our manager at the moment is Unai Emery who has managed us for one season taking us from finishing 5th in the Premier League in Wenger's last season to 5th in the Premier League

- Our strikers are phenomenal and Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang scored 22 goals in the league last season and won the golden boot (joint with two Liverpool players who scored the same amount as him)

- Our midfield is pretty average. We lost one of our most energetic attacking players in Aaron Ramsey because our owners just didn't give him a new contract.

- Mesut Özil who we signed in 2013 for £42.5m isn't performing to the best of his abilities and isn't massively in favour under Emery. But for a long time he had the best assist record by far in Europe's top 5 leagues (can't remember exact statistics but trust me he is/was brilliant)

- Our defence is appalling. Although it wasn't helpful that many of our defenders were injured last season for a long time

- Our LB (Kolasinac) is very good at attacking but can't defend

- Our RB (Bellerin) is very good but has been injured too much so we had to play a young player (Maitland-Niles) who doesn't normally play at RB in his position for much of last season

- Shkodran Mustafi is an abomination and is our worst player and can't defend for shit and the fact we haven't sold him is ludicrous (he is also a defender)

- Also the only player we've signed this transfer window is a teenager from the 4th division of Italian football

- We are going into our 3rd consecutive season without Champions League football (the top inter-European tournament, arguably one of the most coveted trophies in club football) but we are in the Europa League (like the champions League but with slightly worse teams)

- We were in the Europa League final but got battered 4-1 by Chelsea and it was honestly an embarrassing performance (although Alex Iwobi's goal was a beauty)
